extra.reason: Implemented: 4 ore types, depth-based deterministic worldgen distribution, textures, unit tests (12/12 pass). Committed on feat/ores.
Implemented: protocol version + handshake rejection with typed disconnect reasons; net unit tests pass. On feat/netcode-version.
Added --render-distance CLI flag (default 12), plumbed into world_create in main.c
Added --msaa flag, default 1x (off); sample count resolved via pick_sample_count, clamped to device caps; MSAA=1 no-resolve path preserved
Added --aniso flag, default 4x; texture.c sampler uses requested level clamped to maxSamplerAnisotropy, off at 1x
CMake now defaults to Release (-O3 -DNDEBUG); validation layers/debug messenger compiled out via #ifndef NDEBUG; verified -O3 + -DNDEBUG in build flags

Implemented server-side world persistence: block-delta overlay (world_persist module) records every break/place, replays onto generated chunks, saves on shutdown + 30s flush, loads on startup. Pure serialize/deserialize roundtrip + file I/O unit-tested (test_world_persist, 7 cases). Full build clean, all 12 ctests pass. Branch feat/world-persistence.
Added PLANKS/COBBLE/GLASS/PATH blocks at atlas indices 12-15: block.h enum, block.c defs + representative colors, gen_assets.py draw_* generators, regenerated assets. Builds clean.

Implemented day/night cycle: pure src/daynight.{c,h} (phase/brightness/sky/is_dark) with full test_daynight suite; server owns world_ticks broadcast as trailing u32 on PKT_WORLD_STATE (protocol v2); client smoothing; renderer drives sun_color/ambient/clear color; hostile mob spawns gated on darkness; singleplayer local clock. All 14 tests pass, full build clean. Branch feat/day-night (not pushed/merged per task).

Pure village_cell_at (deterministic placement + margin-clamped jitter) and village_is_suitable (sea level/grass/flatness) implemented in src/village.{c,h}; tests/test_village.c verifies determinism, density ~25%, center bounds, suitability gating. New CMake target 'village' wired like test_ore.

village_generate per-chunk intersection loop (3x3 cell scan, AABB reject, suitability via worldgen_get_height) emits houses via chunk_set_block in world coords; flatten platform, plank walls, door gaps, glass windows, flat/peaked roofs. Single-line call site added to worldgen_generate. Cross-chunk seam test passes.

Central cobble/water well with plank posts + cobble canopy, Bresenham gravel PATH from each house door to the well, and footprint terrain flattening (clear-to-air above platform, dirt fill below). Emitted in world coords so pieces split across chunks automatically. Seam test asserts the 3x3 canopy reconstructs completely across chunk boundaries.
Added calloc NULL checks (abort + stderr) in chunk_map_init and rehash; lighting.c and block_physics.c allocations were already checked.
pt_thread_create returns int; Win32 checks malloc'd arg and CreateThread, POSIX checks pthread_create; net_thread_start propagates failure.
Added atomic dropped-packet counter (inbound+outbound) with periodic stderr warning; queue semantics unchanged.
